answer: Resist sybil by binding each identity to a staked 'terrace' of reputation that must be re-earned through a fresh, original semantic answer every epoch. Any 'plume' of clones sharing one vault collapses to a single vote and one attestation weight, while their stacked stakes pool into one slashable unit — so mass-producing fake identities multiplies capital at risk instead of influence gained. A 'hollow' cluster that merely copies answers burns its stake, making cheap identity inflation expensive.
